files.title: Engagement bait starter pack
files.description: Blocks engagement-bait notifications (recommendations, trending, streaks, "come back" nags) across popular social and streaming apps in one import. Direct messages are unaffected.

files.title: Promo spam starter pack
files.description: Blocks promotional notification spam (offers, sales, coupons, cashback) across popular shopping and food delivery apps in one import. Order and delivery updates are unaffected.
